Attached are draft PNR bundles for the Redwood-Novum onsite (Aug 15-17). I broke options out by risk profile:

- Option A (lowest risk): nonstop where available + overnight before first session (preferred for execs)
- Option B (balanced): one short connection under 90 mins (lower cost)
- Option C (fallback): routing via SFO with later arrivals but multiple rebook paths

We flagged a couple of tight connections at LAX for the 6:10a departures — if you want to avoid those entirely, we can shift several legs 40–90 minutes earlier but that changes pricing.

4) Lounge access: yes for Andrew and Laura.

5) Point of contact for arrival notifications: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai and tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
